description: This Java interface defines a serialization context used internally within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages serialization state and configuration, providing methods to write various data types (null, boolean, numbers, strings, field names) into a serialization buffer, and to control the serialization process (close and flush). It is an internal component meant for handling serialization tasks, not for external reuse.

methods.name: writeCachedElement
methods.description: Embeds cached data directly into the buffer; should write exactly one element.

methods.name: writeNull
methods.description: Writes a null value to the serialization context.

methods.name: writeBoolean
methods.description: Writes a boolean value to the serialization context.

methods.name: writeNumber
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write float, double, long, and int numerical values.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string value to the serialization context.

methods.name: writeFieldName
methods.description: Writes a string as a field name in the serialization context.
